name: Newcastle Museum
blurb: Free museum in old rail workshops: steelmaking, city history and hands-on science.
weatherNote: All indoors, so it's a good rainy-day pick in Newcastle. On a fine day, pair it with the coast.
gettingThere: Central Coast & Newcastle Line to Newcastle Interchange (≈ 2 hr 30, hourly), then the light rail two stops to Civic and a 4 min walk.
newcomerTip: Don't miss the steelmaking show in Fire and Earth: it runs on the hour, every hour. Kids love the hands-on science in Supernova.

legs.title: Central Coast & Newcastle Line to Newcastle Interchange
legs.detail: Hourly on weekends. Check the platform at Central

legs.title: Light rail to Civic
legs.detail: Every 15 min on weekends. Or walk from the Interchange, ≈ 20 min

back.text: Same way back: light rail from Civic to Newcastle Interchange, then the Central Coast & Newcastle Line to Central (≈ 2 hr 30, hourly).

drive.perCarLabel: Tolls + Wright Lane parking, 3 hrs, est.
notes: Park at Wright Lane car park next to the museum and pay with the EasyPark app. It has accessible spaces.
Taxi and rideshare drop-off is at the Newcastle Visitor Information Centre on Hunter St, ≈ 150 m away.

routes.ride: Handy from Newcastle Interchange if it's pouring. From Sydney it's too far.

visit.bestTime: Any open day. It's quietest late on weekday afternoons in school term. School holidays and rainy days get busy.
visit.hours: Tuesday to Sunday 10am to 5pm, and Mondays during NSW school holidays. General entry is free; some temporary exhibitions need a ticket.
bring: Nothing special: large bags can be cloaked
facilities: Cloaking for large bags, umbrellas and jackets
Accessible toilets and a Lift and Change room
visit.access: All on one floor, and both entrances and all galleries are wheelchair accessible. Wheelchairs can be borrowed (book ahead). Hearing loop at the information desk. Accessible parking at Wright Lane car park.
safety: Children under 12 must be with an adult at all times

unconfirmed.note: The $10–30 for tolls and 3 hours at Wright Lane car park is a guess: the operator doesn't publish rates on the museum's page.
The $15–30 lunch estimate is ours: the museum doesn't list a café, so check menus at Honeysuckle.
The museum doesn't list its public holiday closures (such as Christmas Day): call before you go on a holiday.
